ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly high-intensity (white) central regions across both lobes, comprising approximately 70% of the visible surface, bounded by low-intensity (black) margins along the trailing edge and lateral tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous white regions occupy the interior of both lobes; thick, low-intensity black banding is localized at the distal tips and along the entire trailing edge perimeter, with a dark triangular cluster at the inferior peduncle junction.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, narrow V-shaped depression with a vertex angle of approximately 45 degrees and significant pixel-depth relative to the lobe width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations along both lobes; trailing edge exhibits a continuous series of jagged peaks and valleys, with more pronounced indentations on the medial side of the left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly concave curve along the trailing edges, terminating in sharply tapered, upward-swept distal tips.

other_distinctive_markers: Highly symmetrical black 'caps' on the distal tips which contrast sharply with the white interior pigmentation.
